caption: The drawing depicts a large, solid object with a symmetrical, geometric structure resembling a chest or box. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black, with the top surface being a lighter gray compared to the darker gray sides. The object has a unique shape, consisting of a roughly oval or elliptical form with four evenly spaced rectangular protrusions extending outward from the sides, creating a cross-like profile when viewed from above. On the front-facing side, there is an ornate keyhole design drawn in black, positioned at the center of one of the wider vertical panels. The surface of the object shows subtle shading that emphasizes its three-dimensional form, and faint horizontal lines run around the object near the top and bottom edges, enhancing its structural detail. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Patch Box
